label.purpose: Eyebrows, metadata, and compact status labels.

motion.name: fast-state
motion.purpose: Button, border, and disclosure state changes.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The clear next action in a setup or working flow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #34d399; color: #04160e; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #10b981; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: A contained working region for draft, team, import, or settings tasks.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: #14171c; color: #f2f4f6; padding: 20px; border: 1px solid #262b33; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.45); }

narrative.overview: A quiet, information-dense operational interface for time-sensitive fantasy decisions. Surface current state and next action first, then progressively disclose evidence, strategy, alternatives, and history.

rules.name: The Semantic Accent Rule
rules.body: Accent colors communicate state or action; do not use them as decoration.

rules.name: The Decision-First Type Rule
rules.body: The current decision gets the strongest weight and contrast, not secondary evidence.

rules.name: The Tonal Layering Rule
rules.body: Prefer surface and border changes over ornamental glow.

dos: Do show the current draft state and next useful action first.
Do preserve the token system and shared primitives.
Do keep progressive disclosure for deep AI context.
donts: Don't overload live draft surfaces with every tool at once.
Don't present deterministic evidence as certainty.
Don't introduce a separate visual language for Team Manager.
